detailed_description:
The target video is a realistic short with warm late-afternoon light, contrasting traditional Hanfu with a modern brick industrial park. [Shot 1] Fixed eye-level wide shot. <Subject 2> fills the frame: the long red-brick factory with its rust-red metal roof runs along the left, the white lattice Canton Tower rises against the blue sky in the distance, tall trees and hedges line the right side, and the green-and-white speech-bubble sculpture stands at the right edge of the road. <Subject 1> stands in the middle of the grey asphalt road facing the camera with a calm, faint smile, arms relaxed at her sides. She wears a crimson-red Hanfu ruqun: a fitted crimson bodice tied high under the chest with a pale-gold sash, thin translucent blush-pink sleeves covering her arms to the wrists, and a very full pleated crimson skirt with a narrow pale-gold embroidered hem. Her dark-brown side-parted hair hangs long and straight over one shoulder; she has no bangs and wears no earrings or necklace. At 00:02.000, she arches backward, plants one hand on the asphalt, and flips her body over; the crimson skirt swings out and opens around her into <Subject 3>, a full semicircular fan of crimson pleats facing the camera; across the center of the open fan two large golden brush-calligraphy characters "广州" read clearly from left to right, with bold flowing strokes, flanked by golden auspicious-cloud motifs on both sides, while a glowing golden arc sweeps along its outer rim and sheds fine golden sparks in the sunlight. Her long brown hair whips downward with the inversion. At 00:04.000, she rolls into a side kneel, one hand lifting the hem to hold the crimson fan open beside her so that "广州" stays visible on the fabric as the golden arc travels up its edge. At 00:06.000, the golden arc fades into drifting sparks; she lowers herself forward and lies prone on the road, arms stretched to both sides, the crimson skirt spread flat to the left and right like an open fan. She lifts her face toward the camera, showing her almond eyes and red lips, and holds still until the end. Warm side light from the low sun rakes across the road, casting long tree shadows over her skirt.

overall_soundscape:
Leaves rustle in a light breeze, distant city traffic hums softly, and a few birds chirp in the trees. Fabric whooshes during the flip and settles with a soft rustle on the asphalt.
